entities.summary: Taibah University is a university in Madinah, Saudi Arabia, is a public research university in Madinah, Saudi Arabia established in 2003. Taibah University has witnessed an enormous increase in the number of its students. The university started as a branch of King Abdulaziz University (KAU) in 1978. In 2003, there were 7,761 enrolled students. Today, there are 20,815 students enrolled.
